native_components.name: Microsoft WebView2 SDK loader
native_components.scope: The supported Windows MSVC build statically links the x64 WebView2 loader supplied in this crate. These Microsoft SDK license and third-party notice texts apply to that native component separately from the Rust crate’s MIT SPDX metadata. The complete SDK NOTICE is retained conservatively. The Microsoft WebView2 Runtime is installed separately on the host and is not bundled in CloudCue.
